Dashboard/báo cáo: Dashboard tổng hợp chấm điểm phân loại CTDC
Thông tin: Mã CK doanh nghiệp
Độ chi tiết: CTDC, ngày
Điều kiện dữ liệu: cp.status_ids_cd = 'APPROVED_PUBLIC'
Câu lệnh update SIT:
SELECT cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER --, cp.bond_ticker
        , a1.total_score, a1.type, aa.TUAN_THU, PHAT_HANH, TAI_CHINH, PHI_TAI_CHINH
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp 
JOIN
(--        điểm tổng (cấp 1)
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date        ,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , 'TONG' group_cd, ev.total_score, ev.type
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id --AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE 1=1
) a1 ON cp.id = a1.COMPANY_ID 
JOIN 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM (--điểm cấp 2
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id --AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd IN ('TUAN_THU', 'PHAT_HANH', 'TAI_CHINH', 'PHI_TAI_CHINH')
                Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
                )
        pivot  (sum(diem)
                FOR group_cd IN ('TUAN_THU' AS TUAN_THU, 'PHAT_HANH' AS PHAT_HANH, 'TAI_CHINH' AS TAI_CHINH, 'PHI_TAI_CHINH' AS PHI_TAI_CHINH
                                                )
                        ) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID 
WHERE a1.per = '202607' AND aa.per = '202607'
AND (cp.delete_flg = 0 OR cp.delete_flg IS NULL)

Câu lệnh update SIT:
SELECT cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp JOIN 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM (--điểm cấp 3
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id --AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'TUAN_THU'
                AND ec.criterion_cd in ('TUAN_THU_BCTC', 'TUAN_THU_BCTN', 'TUAN_THU_BCTHQT', 'TUAN_THU_CBTTBT_TDTGD', 'TUAN_THU_VP_UBCK', 
                                                                'TUAN_THU_CBTTBT_VPVT', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_DLCT', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLDHDCD', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLTVDL', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLTVKDH',

                --điểm cấp 2
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev

                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id

                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'TUAN_THU'
                Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
                )
        pivot  (sum(diem)
                FOR criterion_cd IN ('TUAN_THU' AS TONG, 'TUAN_THU_BCTC' AS BCTC, 'TUAN_THU_BCTN' AS BCTN, 'TUAN_THU_BCTHQT' AS BCTHQT, 'TUAN_THU_CBTTBT_TDTGD' AS CBTTBT_TDTGD, 'TUAN_THU_VP_UBCK' AS VP_UBCK,

Dashboard/báo cáo: Dashboard top chấm điểm phân loại công ty đại chúng theo chỉ tiêu phát hành
Thông tin: Mã doanh nghiệp
Độ chi tiết: CTDC, ngày
Câu lệnh update SIT:
SELECT cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp JOIN 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM (--điểm cấp 3
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id --AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'PHAT_HANH'
                AND ec.criterion_cd in ('PHAT_HANH_TANG_VON_NHANH', 'PHAT_HANH_SLCBCPRL', 'PHAT_HANH_SLCBRCC', 'PHAT_HANH_SLPHES',
                                                      'PHAT_HANH_TLGTTP', 'PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM', 'PHAT_HANH_DNTPTVCSH')
                --điểm cấp 2
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id --AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'PHAT_HANH'
                Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
                )
        pivot  (sum(diem)
                FOR criterion_cd IN ('PHAT_HANH' AS TONG, 'PHAT_HANH_TANG_VON_NHANH' AS TANG_VON_NHANH, 'PHAT_HANH_SLCBCPRL' AS SLCBCPRL, 'PHAT_HANH_SLCBRCC' AS SLCBRCC,
                                                        'PHAT_HANH_SLPHES' AS SLPHES, 'PHAT_HANH_TLGTTP' AS TLGTTP, 'PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM' AS TIN_NHIEM, 'PHAT_HANH_DNTPTVCSH' AS DNTPTVCSH
                                                )
                        ) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID 
WHERE aa.per = '202607' AND aa.per = '202607'
AND (cp.delete_flg = 0 OR cp.delete_flg IS NULL)

Dashboard/báo cáo: Dashboard top chấm điểm phân loại công ty đại chúng theo chỉ tiêu phi tài chính & M- Score
Thông tin: Mã doanh nghiệp
Độ chi tiết: CTDC, ngày
Câu lệnh update SIT:
SELECT cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp JOIN 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM (--điểm cấp 3
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id --AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'PHI_TAI_CHINH'
                AND ec.criterion_cd in ('PHI_TAI_CHINH_TTHD', 'PHI_TAI_CHINH_M_SCORE')
                --điểm cấp 2
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id --AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'PHI_TAI_CHINH'
                Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
                )
        pivot  (sum(diem)
                FOR criterion_cd IN ('PHI_TAI_CHINH' AS TONG, 'PHI_TAI_CHINH_TTHD' AS TTHD, 'PHI_TAI_CHINH_M_SCORE' AS M_SCORE
                                                )
                        ) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID 
WHERE aa.per = '202607' AND aa.per = '202607'
AND (cp.delete_flg = 0 OR cp.delete_flg IS NULL)

WITH
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd, form_tp,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT cd.ds_snpst_dt, f.ds_snpst_dt,
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            substr(f.form_cd,1,2) as form_tp,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                              WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                              WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                              WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                          END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM UAT_IDS_STG.company_data cd
        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
		  AND EXISTS 
		  	(SELECT 1 FROM UAT_IDS_STG.violation_report vr
				JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.forms fv ON fv.id = vr.form_id AND fv.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
				WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id 
				and vr.period_year = cd.report_year 
				and vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter 
				AND vr.DEADLINE_DATE <=current_date
				AND vr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-25'
				AND fv.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-25')
          AND cd.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-25'
          AND f.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-25'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN AS (
      SELECT
            company_profile_id, MA_TEN_CK, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, STATUS_IDS_CD, DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
            report_year, report_quarter,
            sum(case when col_desc = '1' then data_value end) AS LNST,
            sum(case when col_desc = '3' then data_value end) AS LNST_LK
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id, concat(cp.EQUITY_TICKER, ' - ', cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN) AS MA_TEN_CK,
                    cp.STATUS_IDS_CD, cp.ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD AS DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id, rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id, rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date, d.updated_date, d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id AND cp.STATUS_IDS_CD = 'APPROVED_PUBLIC'
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-25'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-25'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-25'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-25'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-25'
                  AND rc2.col_desc in ('1', '3') 
                  AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, MA_TEN_CK, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, STATUS_IDS_CD, DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
            report_year, report_quarter
)

   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA

   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp

   ========================================================= */

    SELECT

        MA_TEN_CK,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id, STATUS_IDS_CD, DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,

        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VDL' THEN data_value END) AS VDL,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNST' THEN data_value END) AS LNST,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNST_LK' THEN data_value END) AS LNST_LK,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'TAI_SAN_DK' THEN data_value END) AS TAI_SAN_DK,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH_DK' THEN data_value END) AS VCSH_DK,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'HTK' THEN data_value END) AS HTK,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'DOANH_THU' THEN data_value END) AS DOANH_THU,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'DOANH_THU_LK' THEN data_value END) AS DOANH_THU_LK,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LN_YTD' THEN data_value END) AS LN_YTD,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'PHAI_THU' THEN data_value END) AS PHAI_THU,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'TIEN' THEN data_value END) AS TIEN,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNTT' THEN data_value END) AS LNTT,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNTT_LK' THEN data_value END) AS LNTT_LK
    FROM (

            CASE

                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='270')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='300')) THEN 'TAI_SAN'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='300')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='300')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='400')) THEN 'NO_PT'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='411')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='411')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='411')) THEN 'VDL'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'
                WHEN col_desc = '3' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST_LK'
                WHEN col_desc = '2' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='270')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='270')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='300')) THEN 'TAI_SAN_DK'
                WHEN col_desc = '2' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH_DK'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='140')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='140')) THEN 'HTK'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
                WHEN col_desc = '3' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU_LK'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='421')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='421')) THEN 'LN_YTD'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc IN ('130','210'))
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc IN ('130','210'))
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc IN ('251'))) THEN 'PHAI_THU'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='110')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='110')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc IN ('110','120'))) THEN 'TIEN'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='50')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='50')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='17')) THEN 'LNTT'
                WHEN col_desc = '3' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='50')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='50')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='17')) THEN 'LNTT_LK'                      
            END AS chi_tieu,
            data_value
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id, concat(cp.EQUITY_TICKER, ' - ', cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN) AS MA_TEN_CK,
                    cp.STATUS_IDS_CD, cp.ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD AS DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year,
                    cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id,
                    rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id,
                    rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date,
                    d.updated_date,
                    d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp
                  ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
                  ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                 AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                 AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
                  ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                 AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
                  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                 AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
                  ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
                 AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2','3','4')
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) q
    WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, MA_TEN_CK, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter, STATUS_IDS_CD, DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD
)
/* -------------------------------------------
BƯỚC 3.3: Nếu tính các chỉ tiêu toàn ngành
*/
SELECT-- category_l1_id, concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME) AS NNKD,
        report_year, report_quarter,
        count(1)         AS SL,
        SUM(TAI_SAN) AS TAI_SAN,
        SUM(NO_PT)         AS NO_PT,
        SUM(VCSH)        AS VCSH,
        SUM(VDL)        AS VDL,
        SUM(LNST)        AS LNST, SUM(LNST_LK)        AS LNST_LK,
        --Nếu đầu kỳ null thì mẫu số =(cuối + cuối)/2 = cuối, tương tự nếu cuối kỳ null thì mẫu số = đầu, nếu cả 2 null thì ROA=null
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN TAI_SAN ELSE TAI_SAN_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN TAI_SAN_DK ELSE TAI_SAN END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROA,
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN VCSH ELSE VCSH_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN VCSH_DK ELSE VCSH END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROE,
        SUM(LNST_LK)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN TAI_SAN ELSE TAI_SAN_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN TAI_SAN_DK ELSE TAI_SAN END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROA_LK,
        SUM(LNST_LK)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN VCSH ELSE VCSH_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN VCSH_DK ELSE VCSH END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROE_LK,
        SUM(TAI_SAN_DK)        AS TAI_SAN_DK,
        SUM(HTK)                AS HTK,
        SUM(DOANH_THU)        AS DOANH_THU,
        SUM(LN_YTD)         AS LN_YTD,
        SUM(PHAI_THU)        AS PHAI_THU,
        SUM(TIEN)                AS TIEN,
        SUM(NO_PT)/NULLIF(SUM(VCSH),0) AS D_E,
        SUM(LNTT)                AS LNTT,         SUM(LNTT_LK)                AS LNTT_LK
FROM Chitiet_DN ct
LEFT JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = ct.category_l1_id AND c.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
where 1=1 
        AND report_year = ${hivevar:p_year}
        AND report_quarter = ${hivevar:p_quarter}
GROUP BY report_year, report_quarter--, category_l1_id, concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME)
ORDER BY report_year, report_quarter

WITH Company_data_chuan AS (...),
Chitiet_DN as (...)
--Bước 1,2, giống mục 7
/* -------------------------------------------
BƯỚC 3.2: Nếu tính các chỉ tiêu theo sàn, ngành
*/
SELECT category_l1_id, concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME) AS NNKD,
        report_year, report_quarter,
        count(1)         AS SL,
        SUM(TAI_SAN) AS TAI_SAN,
        SUM(NO_PT)         AS NO_PT,
        SUM(VCSH)        AS VCSH,
        SUM(VDL)        AS VDL,
        SUM(LNST)        AS LNST, SUM(LNST_LK)        AS LNST_LK,
        --Nếu đầu kỳ null thì mẫu số =(cuối + cuối)/2 = cuối, tương tự nếu cuối kỳ null thì mẫu số = đầu, nếu cả 2 null thì ROA=null
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN TAI_SAN ELSE TAI_SAN_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN TAI_SAN_DK ELSE TAI_SAN END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROA,
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN VCSH ELSE VCSH_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN VCSH_DK ELSE VCSH END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROE,
        SUM(LNST_LK)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN TAI_SAN ELSE TAI_SAN_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN TAI_SAN_DK ELSE TAI_SAN END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROA_LK,
        SUM(LNST_LK)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN VCSH ELSE VCSH_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN VCSH_DK ELSE VCSH END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROE_LK,
        SUM(TAI_SAN_DK)        AS TAI_SAN_DK,
        SUM(HTK)                AS HTK,
        SUM(DOANH_THU)        AS DOANH_THU,
        SUM(LN_YTD)         AS LN_YTD,
        SUM(PHAI_THU)        AS PHAI_THU,
        SUM(TIEN)                AS TIEN,
        SUM(NO_PT)/NULLIF(SUM(VCSH),0) AS D_E,
        SUM(LNTT)                AS LNTT,         SUM(LNTT_LK)                AS LNTT_LK
FROM Chitiet_DN ct
LEFT JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = ct.category_l1_id AND c.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
where 1=1 
        AND report_year = ${hivevar:p_year}
        AND report_quarter = ${hivevar:p_quarter}
GROUP BY report_year, report_quarter, category_l1_id, concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME)
ORDER BY report_year, report_quarter

Dashboard/báo cáo: Dashboard Giám sát tổng hợp theo sàn HNX - Thống kê niêm yết theo sàn
Thông tin: Tỷ lệ nộp BCTC theo từng sàn (quý)
Mô tả: Là tỷ lệ % doanh nghiệp trên mỗi sàn giao dịch đã nộp báo cáo tài chính quý đúng kỳ báo cáo.
Độ chi tiết: Quý/Năm, Sàn
Bảng nguồn:
violation_report vr
forms f ON  f.id
company_profiles cp
Trường nguồn:
cp.equity_listing_exch       AS san,
       ROUND(COUNT(vr.actual_submit_date) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(vr.id), 0),2) AS ty_le_da_nop_pct
Điều kiện dữ liệu:
vr.period_year                 = :p_nam
  AND (vr.period_quarter = :p_quy OR :p_quy IS NULL)
  AND vr.deadline_date              <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
  AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
  AND cp.equity_listing_exch = 'HNX'
GROUP BY cp.equity_listing_exch

Thông tin: Tổng tài sản
Mô tả: Σ Tổng tài sản của tất cả DN trên sàn
Độ chi tiết: Quý/Năm, Sàn
Điều kiện dữ liệu:
rc2.col_desc = '1'
 AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
 AND ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'HNX'
GROUP BY cdet.equity_listing_exch
Câu lệnh update SIT:
WITH Company_data_chuan AS (...),
Chitiet_DN as (...)
--Bước 1,2, giống mục 7
/* -------------------------------------------
BƯỚC 3.3: Nếu tính các chỉ tiêu theo sàn, ngành
*/
SELECT equity_listing_exch,--category_l1_id, concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME) AS NNKD,
        report_year, report_quarter,
        count(1)         AS SL,
        SUM(TAI_SAN) AS TAI_SAN,
        SUM(NO_PT)         AS NO_PT,
        SUM(VCSH)        AS VCSH,
        SUM(VDL)        AS VDL,
        SUM(LNST)        AS LNST, SUM(LNST_LK)        AS LNST_LK,
        --Nếu đầu kỳ null thì mẫu số =(cuối + cuối)/2 = cuối, tương tự nếu cuối kỳ null thì mẫu số = đầu, nếu cả 2 null thì ROA=null
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN TAI_SAN ELSE TAI_SAN_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN TAI_SAN_DK ELSE TAI_SAN END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROA,
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN VCSH ELSE VCSH_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN VCSH_DK ELSE VCSH END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROE,
        SUM(LNST_LK)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN TAI_SAN ELSE TAI_SAN_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN TAI_SAN_DK ELSE TAI_SAN END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROA_LK,
        SUM(LNST_LK)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN VCSH ELSE VCSH_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN VCSH_DK ELSE VCSH END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROE_LK,
        SUM(TAI_SAN_DK)        AS TAI_SAN_DK,
        SUM(HTK)                AS HTK,
        SUM(DOANH_THU)        AS DOANH_THU,
        SUM(LN_YTD)         AS LN_YTD,
        SUM(PHAI_THU)        AS PHAI_THU,
        SUM(TIEN)                AS TIEN,
        SUM(NO_PT)/NULLIF(SUM(VCSH),0) AS D_E,
        SUM(LNTT)                AS LNTT,         SUM(LNTT_LK)                AS LNTT_LK
FROM Chitiet_DN ct
LEFT JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = ct.category_l1_id AND c.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
where 1=1 
        AND report_year = ${hivevar:p_year}
        AND report_quarter = ${hivevar:p_quarter}
GROUP BY report_year, report_quarter--, category_l1_id, concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME)
, equity_listing_exch
ORDER BY report_year, report_quarter

WITH Company_data_chuan AS (...),

--Bước 1,2, giống mục 7
/* -------------------------------------------
BƯỚC 3.2: Nếu tính các chỉ tiêu theo sàn, ngành
*/
SELECT equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME) AS NNKD,
        report_year, report_quarter,
        count(1)         AS SL,
        SUM(TAI_SAN) AS TAI_SAN,
        SUM(NO_PT)         AS NO_PT,
        SUM(VCSH)        AS VCSH,
        SUM(VDL)        AS VDL,
        SUM(LNST)        AS LNST, SUM(LNST_LK)        AS LNST_LK,
        --Nếu đầu kỳ null thì mẫu số =(cuối + cuối)/2 = cuối, tương tự nếu cuối kỳ null thì mẫu số = đầu, nếu cả 2 null thì ROA=null
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN TAI_SAN ELSE TAI_SAN_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN TAI_SAN_DK ELSE TAI_SAN END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROA,
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN VCSH ELSE VCSH_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN VCSH_DK ELSE VCSH END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROE,
        SUM(LNST_LK)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN TAI_SAN ELSE TAI_SAN_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN TAI_SAN_DK ELSE TAI_SAN END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROA_LK,
        SUM(LNST_LK)/NULLIF(SUM(
                  CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN VCSH ELSE VCSH_DK END
                + CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN VCSH_DK ELSE VCSH END
                )/2,0)*100 as ROE_LK,
        SUM(TAI_SAN_DK)        AS TAI_SAN_DK,
        SUM(HTK)                AS HTK,
        SUM(DOANH_THU)        AS DOANH_THU,
        SUM(LN_YTD)         AS LN_YTD,
        SUM(PHAI_THU)        AS PHAI_THU,
        SUM(TIEN)                AS TIEN,
        SUM(NO_PT)/NULLIF(SUM(VCSH),0) AS D_E,
        SUM(LNTT)                AS LNTT,         SUM(LNTT_LK)                AS LNTT_LK
FROM Chitiet_DN ct
LEFT JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = ct.category_l1_id AND c.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
where 1=1 
        AND report_year = ${hivevar:p_year}
        AND report_quarter = ${hivevar:p_quarter}
GROUP BY report_year, report_quarter, category_l1_id, concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME)
, equity_listing_exch
ORDER BY report_year, report_quarter

Câu lệnh update SIT:
WITH
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd, form_tp,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT cd.ds_snpst_dt, f.ds_snpst_dt,
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
                        substr(f.form_cd,1,2) as form_tp,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE         WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                                                        END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM UAT_IDS_STG.company_data cd
        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND cd.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
          AND f.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN AS (
      SELECT
            company_profile_id, MA_TEN_CK, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, STATUS_IDS_CD, DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
            report_year, report_quarter,
            data_value AS VDL
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM ( SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id, concat(cp.EQUITY_TICKER, ' - ', cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN) AS MA_TEN_CK,
                    cp.STATUS_IDS_CD, cp.ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD AS DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id, rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id, rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date, d.updated_date, d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND rc2.col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='411')
                      OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='411')
                      OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='411'))
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
)     
-- BƯỚC 3: Đếm CTĐC quy mô lớn (UPCOM/OTC, vốn góp CSH >= 120 tỷ, kỳ gần nhất có dữ liệu)
SELECT cp.equity_listing_exch,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ct.company_profile_id) AS so_ctdc_quy_mo_lon
FROM (
    SELECT ct.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ct.company_profile_id ORDER BY ct.report_year DESC, NVL(ct.report_quarter, 0) DESC ) AS rn
    FROM Chitiet_DN ct
    WHERE ct.report_year * 10 + NVL(ct.report_quarter, 0) <= :p_year * 10 + NVL(:p_quarter, 0)
) ct
JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = ct.company_profile_id
WHERE cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
  AND ct.rn              = 1
  AND ct.VDL             >= 120000000000
  AND cp.status_ids_cd   = 'APPROVED_PUBLIC'
  AND cp.equity_listing_exch IN ('UPCOM', 'OTC')
  AND (cp.delete_flg     = 0 OR cp.delete_flg IS NULL)
  AND (cp.ids_reg_date   IS NULL
       OR cp.ids_reg_date <= LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(:p_year || '-01-01', 'yyyy-MM-dd'), :p_quarter * 3 - 1)))
GROUP BY cp.equity_listing_exch

Thông tin: Tổng tài sản
Mô tả: Chi tiết công thức tổng hợp tại sheet CSĐC_công thức CT
Độ chi tiết: kỳ quý hoặc năm hoặc bán niên, sàn, Ngành, CTDC, chỉ tiêu BC
Bảng nguồn:
IDS.data (d), IDS.report_catalog (rc), IDS.rrow (rr),
 IDS.rcol (rc2), IDS.company_data (cd),
 IDS.company_profiles (cp), IDS.categories (cat)
Điều kiện dữ liệu: BCDKT% | col_desc='1' | row_desc: '270'(dn/bh), '300'(td)
Câu lệnh update SIT:
WITH Company_data_chuan AS (...),
Chitiet_DN as (...)
--Bước 1,2, giống mục 7
/* ----------------------------------------
BƯỚC 3.1: Nếu tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng doanh nghiệp
*/
SELECT
        company_profile_id, DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD, STATUS_IDS_CD,
        MA_TEN_CK, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, 
        report_year, report_quarter,
        concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME) AS NNKD,
        TAI_SAN, TAI_SAN_DK,
        (  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN ct.TAI_SAN ELSE ct.TAI_SAN_DK END
         + CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN ct.TAI_SAN_DK ELSE ct.TAI_SAN END ) / 2 AS TAI_SAN_TB,
        NO_PT,
        VCSH, VCSH_DK,
        (  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN ct.VCSH ELSE ct.VCSH_DK END
         + CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN ct.VCSH_DK ELSE ct.VCSH END ) / 2 AS VCSH_TB,
        VDL,
        LNST, LNST_LK,
        --Nếu đầu kỳ null thì mẫu số =(cuối + cuối)/2 = cuối, tương tự nếu cuối kỳ null thì mẫu số = đầu, nếu cả 2 null thì ROA=null
        ct.LNST / NULLIF( (  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN ct.TAI_SAN ELSE ct.TAI_SAN_DK END
                           + CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN ct.TAI_SAN_DK ELSE ct.TAI_SAN END ) / 2, 0) * 100 AS ROA,
        ct.LNST / NULLIF( (  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN ct.VCSH ELSE ct.VCSH_DK END
                           + CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN ct.VCSH_DK ELSE ct.VCSH END ) / 2, 0) * 100 AS ROE,
        ct.LNST_LK / NULLIF( (  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN ct.TAI_SAN ELSE ct.TAI_SAN_DK END
                           + CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN ct.TAI_SAN_DK ELSE ct.TAI_SAN END ) / 2, 0) * 100 AS ROA_LK,
        ct.LNST_LK / NULLIF( (  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN ct.VCSH ELSE ct.VCSH_DK END
                           + CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN ct.VCSH_DK ELSE ct.VCSH END ) / 2, 0) * 100 AS ROE_LK,
        HTK,
        DOANH_THU, DOANH_THU_LK,
        LN_YTD,
        PHAI_THU,
        TIEN,
        NO_PT/NULLIF(VCSH,0) AS D_E,
        ct.LNTT, ct.LNTT_LK,
        CASE WHEN ct.LNST > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DNBaoLai,
        CASE WHEN ct.LNST_LK > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DNBaoLai_LK
FROM Chitiet_DN ct
LEFT JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = ct.category_l1_id AND c.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-24'
where 1=1 
        AND report_year in (${hivevar:p_year})
        AND report_quarter in (${hivevar:p_quarter})
ORDER BY company_profile_id, MA_TEN_CK, report_year, report_quarter

Câu lệnh update SIT:
WITH
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd, form_tp,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
                        substr(f.form_cd,1,2) as form_tp,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE         WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                                                        END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM UAT_IDS_STG.company_data cd
        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND cd.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
          AND f.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN as
(        SELECT 
                company_profile_id, MA_TEN_CK, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, enterprise_type_cd, DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
                report_year, report_quarter,report_cd, --col_id, 
                col_desc, row_id, row_desc,
                data_value
        FROM (
                Select x.*,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC) AS rn
                FROM (
                        SELECT 
                                cdc.company_profile_id, concat(cp.EQUITY_TICKER, ' - ', cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN) AS MA_TEN_CK, cp.equity_listing_exch, cp.category_l1_id , 
                                rc.enterprise_type_cd,cp.STATUS_IDS_CD, cp.ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD AS DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
                                cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter,rc.report_cd, rc2.id as col_id, rc2.col_desc, rr.id as row_id, rr.row_desc,
                                d.data_value, 
                                d.created_date, d.updated_date, d.id AS data_id
                        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                                AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                                AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id and cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        WHERE 1=1--
                                AND cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                                AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                                AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                                AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                                AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                                --and UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH'
                                --AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1', '2', '3', '4')--chỉ tiêu cuối kỳ, thay bằng 2 để test chỉ tiêu cuối kỳ
                        ) x
                )
        WHERE rn = 1
)
/* ----------------------------------------
BƯỚC 3.1: Nếu tính các chỉ tiêu chi tiết DN
*/
SELECT
    concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME) AS NNKD,
    cd.company_profile_id, cd.MA_TEN_CK, cd.equity_listing_exch, cd.category_l1_id,
    cd.enterprise_type_cd, cd.DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
    cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter, cd.report_cd,
    cd.row_id, cd.row_desc,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cd.col_desc = '1' THEN cd.data_value END) AS cuoiky,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cd.col_desc = '2' THEN cd.data_value END) AS dauky,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cd.col_desc = '3' THEN cd.data_value END) AS LuyKe_namnay,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cd.col_desc = '4' THEN cd.data_value END) AS LuyKe_namtruoc
FROM Chitiet_DN cd
LEFT JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = cd.category_l1_id and c.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
WHERE 1=1
  AND cd.report_year IN (${hivevar:YEAR})
  AND cd.report_quarter IN (${hivevar:quarter})
--AND cd.company_profile_id = ${hivevar:p_dn}
--AND cd.company_profile_id = 1230
--AND cd.row_desc = '270'
GROUP BY
    concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME),
    cd.company_profile_id, cd.MA_TEN_CK, cd.equity_listing_exch, cd.category_l1_id,
    cd.enterprise_type_cd, cd.dn_enterprise_type_cd,
    cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter, cd.report_cd,
    cd.row_id, cd.row_desc

Thông tin: Mã doanh nghiệp
Độ chi tiết: Tháng, sàn, Ngành, CTDC
Mapping (nghiệp vụ): select mã doanh nghiệp,.... from A join B ...where...
Điều kiện dữ liệu: cp.status_ids_cd = 'APPROVED_PUBLIC'
Câu lệnh update SIT:
SELECT 
        cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, 
        cp.category_l1_id, c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME AS NNKD,--thêm đk này trong dataexplorer
        aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp 
JOIN 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM (--điểm cấp 2
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd IN ('TUAN_THU', 'PHAT_HANH', 'TAI_CHINH', 'PHI_TAI_CHINH')
                Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
                --        điểm tổng (cấp 1)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date        ,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , 'TONG' group_cd, ev.total_score AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE 1=1
                --điểm cấp 3
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem_phat_hanh_nhanh
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE ec.criterion_cd = 'PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM'
                AND eg.group_cd = 'PHAT_HANH'
                )
        pivot  (sum(diem)
                FOR group_cd IN ('TONG' AS TONG, 'TUAN_THU' AS TUAN_THU, 'PHAT_HANH' AS PHAT_HANH, 'TAI_CHINH' AS TAI_CHINH, 'PHI_TAI_CHINH' AS PHI_TAI_CHINH
                                                ,'PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM' AS PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM
                                                )
                        ) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID 
LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = cp.category_l1_id--thêm trong dataexxplorer

Dashboard/báo cáo: Dữ liệu về phân loại công ty đại chúng theo chỉ tiêu tuân thủ
Thông tin: Mã doanh nghiệp
Độ chi tiết: Tháng, sàn, Ngành, CTDC
Điều kiện dữ liệu: cp.status_ids_cd = 'APPROVED_PUBLIC'
Câu lệnh update SIT:
SELECT cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp JOIN 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM (--điểm cấp 3
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , criterion_cd--, ed.score AS diem
                , (CASE WHEN evaluate =1 THEN 'Bình thường: '
                                WHEN evaluate =2 THEN 'Cảnh báo: '
                                WHEN evaluate =3 THEN 'Rủi ro: '
                                ELSE 'NULL: ' END)                ||RESULT AS KQ
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id --AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'TUAN_THU'
                AND ec.criterion_cd in ('TUAN_THU_BCTC', 'TUAN_THU_BCTN', 'TUAN_THU_BCTHQT', 'TUAN_THU_CBTTBT_TDTGD', 'TUAN_THU_VP_UBCK', 
                                                                'TUAN_THU_CBTTBT_VPVT', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_DLCT', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLDHDCD', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLTVDL', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLTVKDH', 
                                                                'TUAN_THU_QTCT_TCTV', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLTVBKS', 'TUAN_THU_BCSDV_BCTDSDV', 'TUAN_THU_BCSDV_TDPASDV')
                )
        pivot  (max(KQ)--, max (result)
                FOR criterion_cd IN ('TUAN_THU_BCTC' AS BCTC, 'TUAN_THU_BCTN' AS BCTN, 'TUAN_THU_BCTHQT' AS BCTHQT, 'TUAN_THU_CBTTBT_TDTGD' AS CBTTBT_TDTGD, 'TUAN_THU_VP_UBCK' AS VP_UBCK, 
                                                                'TUAN_THU_CBTTBT_VPVT' AS CBTTBT_VPVT, 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_DLCT' AS QTCT_DLCT, 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLDHDCD' AS QTCT_SLDHDCD, 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLTVDL' AS QTCT_SLTVDL, 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLTVKDH' AS QTCT_SLTVKDH, 
                                                                'TUAN_THU_QTCT_TCTV' AS QTCT_TCTV, 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLTVBKS' AS QTCT_SLTVBKS, 'TUAN_THU_BCSDV_BCTDSDV' AS BCSDV_BCTDSDV, 'TUAN_THU_BCSDV_TDPASDV' AS BCSDV_TDPASDV
                                                )
                        ) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID 
WHERE aa.per = '202607' AND aa.per = '202607'
AND (cp.delete_flg = 0 OR cp.delete_flg IS NULL)

Dashboard/báo cáo: Dữ liệu về phân loại công ty đại chúng theo chỉ tiêu phi tài chính & M- Score
Thông tin: Mã doanh nghiệp
Độ chi tiết: Tháng, sàn, Ngành, CTDC
Điều kiện dữ liệu: cp.status_ids_cd = 'APPROVED_PUBLIC'
Câu lệnh update SIT:
SELECT cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp JOIN 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM (--điểm cấp 3
            SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
            company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
            , criterion_cd--, ed.score AS diem
			, (CASE WHEN evaluate =1 THEN 'Bình thường: '
				WHEN evaluate =2 THEN 'Cảnh báo: '
				WHEN evaluate =3 THEN 'Rủi ro: '
				ELSE 'NULL: ' END)		||RESULT AS KQ
            FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
            JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
            JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
            JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
            JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id --AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
            WHERE 1=1
            AND eg.group_cd = 'PHI_TAI_CHINH'
            AND ec.criterion_cd in ('PHI_TAI_CHINH_TTHD', 'PHI_TAI_CHINH_M_SCORE')
            )
        pivot  (max(KQ)
                FOR criterion_cd IN ('PHI_TAI_CHINH_TTHD' AS TTHD, 'PHI_TAI_CHINH_M_SCORE' AS M_SCORE
                                                )
                        ) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID 
WHERE aa.per = '202607' AND aa.per = '202607'
AND (cp.delete_flg = 0 OR cp.delete_flg IS NULL)

Câu lệnh update SIT:
WITH Company_data_chuan AS (...),
Chitiet_DN as (...)
--Bước 1,2, giống mục 7
/* -------------------------------------------
BƯỚC 3.2: Nếu tính các chỉ tiêu theo sàn, ngành, loại DN
*/
SELECT equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME) AS NNKD,
	report_year, report_quarter,
	count(1) 	AS SL,
	SUM(TAI_SAN) AS TAI_SAN,
	SUM(NO_PT) 	AS NO_PT,
	SUM(VCSH)	AS VCSH,
	SUM(VDL)	AS VDL,
	SUM(LNST)	AS LNST, SUM(LNST_LK)	AS LNST_LK,
	--Nếu đầu kỳ null thì mẫu số =(cuối + cuối)/2 = cuối, tương tự nếu cuối kỳ null thì mẫu số = đầu, nếu cả 2 null thì ROA=null
	SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM(
		  CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN TAI_SAN ELSE TAI_SAN_DK END
		+ CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN TAI_SAN_DK ELSE TAI_SAN END
		)/2,0)*100 as ROA,
	SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM(
		  CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN VCSH ELSE VCSH_DK END
		+ CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN VCSH_DK ELSE VCSH END
		)/2,0)*100 as ROE,
	SUM(LNST_LK)/NULLIF(SUM(
		  CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN_DK,0) = 0 THEN TAI_SAN ELSE TAI_SAN_DK END
		+ CASE WHEN COALESCE(TAI_SAN,0)    = 0 THEN TAI_SAN_DK ELSE TAI_SAN END
		)/2,0)*100 as ROA_LK,
	SUM(LNST_LK)/NULLIF(SUM(
		  CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH_DK,0) = 0 THEN VCSH ELSE VCSH_DK END
		+ CASE WHEN COALESCE(VCSH,0)    = 0 THEN VCSH_DK ELSE VCSH END
		)/2,0)*100 as ROE_LK,
	SUM(TAI_SAN_DK)	AS TAI_SAN_DK,
	SUM(HTK)		AS HTK,
	SUM(DOANH_THU)	AS DOANH_THU,
	SUM(LN_YTD) 	AS LN_YTD,
	SUM(PHAI_THU)	AS PHAI_THU,
	SUM(TIEN)		AS TIEN,
	SUM(NO_PT)/NULLIF(SUM(VCSH),0) AS D_E,
	SUM(LNTT)		AS LNTT, 	SUM(LNTT_LK)		AS LNTT_LK
FROM Chitiet_DN ct
LEFT JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = ct.category_l1_id AND c.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
where 1=1 
	AND report_year = ${hivevar:p_year}
	AND report_quarter = ${hivevar:p_quarter}
GROUP BY report_year, report_quarter, category_l1_id, concat(c.INDUSTRY_CD, '-', c.INDUSTRY_NAME)
, equity_listing_exch
ORDER BY report_year, report_quarter

WITH
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd, form_tp,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT cd.ds_snpst_dt, f.ds_snpst_dt,
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
                        substr(f.form_cd,1,2) as form_tp,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE         WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                                                        END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM UAT_IDS_STG.company_data cd
        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND cd.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
          AND f.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN AS (
      SELECT
            company_profile_id, MA_TEN_CK, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, STATUS_IDS_CD, DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
            report_year, report_quarter,
            sum(case when col_desc = '1' then data_value end) AS LNST,
            sum(case when col_desc = '3' then data_value end) AS LNST_LK
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id, concat(cp.EQUITY_TICKER, ' - ', cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN) AS MA_TEN_CK,
                    cp.STATUS_IDS_CD, cp.ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD AS DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id, rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id, rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date, d.updated_date, d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-09-05'
                  AND rc2.col_desc in ('1', '3') 
                  AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, MA_TEN_CK, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, STATUS_IDS_CD, DN_ENTERPRISE_TYPE_CD,
            report_year, report_quarter
)

-- BC01.2: Tổng hợp DTT, LNST, ROA, ROE theo ngành, kỳ năm (report_quarter IS NULL)
 -- Năm N = :year_n, Năm N-1 = :year_n - 1
 WITH kqkd AS (
  -- DTT và LNST từ BCKQKD, kỳ năm
  SELECT cat.industry_cd, cat.industry_name, cd.report_year,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='10')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='10')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='03') THEN d.data_value END) AS dtt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='60')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='60')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='21') THEN d.data_value END) AS lnst
  FROM IDS.data d
 JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
 JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd=d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd=d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
 JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id=d.company_profile_id
 JOIN IDS.categories cat ON cat.id=cp.category_l1_id
  WHERE rc2.col_desc='1' AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
  AND cd.report_quarter IS NULL
  AND cd.report_year IN (:year_n, :year_n-1)
  GROUP BY cat.industry_cd, cat.industry_name, cd.report_year
 ), bcdkt AS (
  -- TS và VCSH từ BCĐKT, cả cuối kỳ (col_desc='1') và đầu kỳ (col_desc='2') để tính bình quân
  SELECT cat.industry_cd, cd.report_year,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300')) AND rc2.col_desc='1' THEN d.data_value END) AS ts_cuoi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300')) AND rc2.col_desc='2' THEN d.data_value END) AS ts_dau,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='400')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='400')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='500')) AND rc2.col_desc='1' THEN d.data_value END) AS vcsh_cuoi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='400')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='400')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='500')) AND rc2.col_desc='2' THEN d.data_value END) AS vcsh_dau
  FROM IDS.data d
 JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
 JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd=d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd=d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
 JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id=d.company_profile_id
 JOIN IDS.categories cat ON cat.id=cp.category_l1_id
  WHERE rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2') AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
  AND cd.report_quarter IS NULL
  AND cd.report_year IN (:year_n, :year_n-1)
  GROUP BY cat.industry_cd, cd.report_year
 )
 SELECT k.industry_cd, k.industry_name,
  -- Năm N
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n THEN ROUND(k.dtt/1e9,2) END) AS dtt_nam_n,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n THEN ROUND(k.lnst/1e9,2) END) AS lnst_nam_n,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n THEN ROUND(k.lnst/NULLIF((b.ts_cuoi+b.ts_dau)/2,0)*100,4) END) AS roa_nam_n,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n THEN ROUND(k.lnst/NULLIF((b.vcsh_cuoi+b.vcsh_dau)/2,0)*100,4) END) AS roe_nam_n,
  -- Năm N-1
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n-1 THEN ROUND(k.dtt/1e9,2) END) AS dtt_nam_n1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n-1 THEN ROUND(k.lnst/1e9,2) END) AS lnst_nam_n1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n-1 THEN ROUND(k.lnst/NULLIF((b.ts_cuoi+b.ts_dau)/2,0)*100,4) END) AS roa_nam_n1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n-1 THEN ROUND(k.lnst/NULLIF((b.vcsh_cuoi+b.vcsh_dau)/2,0)*100,4) END) AS roe_nam_n1
 FROM kqkd k
 JOIN bcdkt b ON b.industry_cd=k.industry_cd AND b.report_year=k.report_year
 GROUP BY k.industry_cd, k.industry_name
 ORDER BY k.industry_cd
